tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stag lung zhabs drung gi gsung lan bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/¿gsung phebs pa'i dri ba dang po/ rang lugs kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed pa la/ dus zhabs pa chen pos rigs ldan gang la dus 'khor gsan par brjed/ ces phebs pa la/ spyir bod yul 'dir grags che ba la/ sham+bha la'i chos rgyal rigs ldan thams cad/ sku tshe'i tshad lo brgya phrag re re yin zhes zer zhing*/ de la brten nas rang rang gi blo dpyad pa'i gtan tshigs 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma rang zhig byung*/ de yang shong lo dang thang ston man chad 'di la byung*/ sngon gyi gyi jo dang rwa 'bro tsa mi sogs kyi skabs dpyad pa cher med/ gtan tshigs mi 'dra ba la brten nas/ spyan 'dren rgya gar du dus 'khor gyi rgyud pa po rnams kyis rigs ldan gang la thug 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung pa der 'dug /rang lugs la chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams mi lo brgya phrag re re bzhugs bya ba de yang*/ sku tshe hril po'i tshad ma yin/ seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ chos ston pa'i tshad yin/ don la gdan sa mdzad pa'i lo grangs su gda'/ rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang rgyal dka' gnyis ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad khri thog tu lo brgya phrag bzhugs pa kho na yin pas/ rags pa'i skad du rigs ldan rnams lo brgyar chos ston ces pa'ang mi 'gal te/ shas che ba brjod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe sangs rgyas 'byon zhes pa yang*/ de skabs kyi mi tshe lo brgya las ring ba yang yod/ thung ba yang yod mod kyi/ phal che ba'i tshe tshad lo brgya yin pa la bsams pa bzhin dang*/ tshogs pa thams cad la khal re bkye'o zhes zer na/ 'ga' zhig la nyis mgo gsum mgo byung yang phal cher la bsams pa yin pas mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /de la rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyis lo brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis chos bstan/ de rjes rgyal dkas nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig chos bstan/ de gnyis sdoms pa la me mkha' rgya mtsho ste/

lo bzhi brgya dang gsum song*/ de yang kun mkhyen chen po nas sku tshe'i stod la rwa 'bro rnams kyi gsung 'phros skyar ba las rang bzhed gsal kha ma mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa dpyad pa mthar phyin pa'i rang bzhed la 'di ltar mdzad/ de'i dbang du byas na/ rigs ldan rgyal dkas chos bstan pa'i 'jug gi cha la/ dus 'khor zhabs pa chen pos gsan/ lo grangs ji tsam bsten gyi nges pa med de/ rgyal dka'i gdan sa'i dus rdzogs mtshams la thug gi bar sham+bha lar bzhugs/ me mkha' rgya mtsho'i lo rdzogs mtshams de nas rab byung gi lo shar ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ 'phags yul du dus 'khor gyi rgyud spyan drangs pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di tsam zhig yid brtan thub par 'dug lags/༈ lam 'bras lugs srol bco brgyad las bcu gnyis su bsdu tshul ji ltar yin gsung pa la/ gyi jo/ 'brom zhang ston/ zha ma/ ko brag pa/ mang lam pa/ cha gan pa ga shi /kun spangs chen po/ dbang rgyal ba/ sa skya ba/ khams lugs/ lce sgom lugs te bcu gnyis por 'dus/ yang nyi shu rtsa bzhir dbye ba gang yin phebs pa'ang dngos su bco brgyad las logs su med/ zha ma pho brgyud la slob brgyud sras brgyud gnyis yod pa'i/ slob brgyud la se sgom grags rgyal lugs dang*/ rje mal gro ba'i lugs gnyis byung*/ sras brgyud la gcigaslob brgyud la gnyis te/ gsum byung ba'i gcig bco brgyad kyi dkyus la bcugalhag ma gnyis dang*/ mo brgyud la smon dkar ba'i lugs dang*/ ston chung lugs dang*/ dbon po shes tshul gyi lugs te gsum yod pa las/ dang po bco brgyad kyi dkyus su bgrong*/ phyi ma gnyis po bsnan pas bzhi/ se ston kun rig gi slob ma zha ma lcam sring dang*/ zhang ston sku mched bco brgyad kyi dkyus la yod/ slob ma gzhan la gnang ba la/ sgom pa byang ye dang*/ grub thob nyi phug pa la gnang ba rnams/

man ngag tha mar thob pa/ zhes grags pa la nyi phug pa nas brgyud pa med/ sgom pa byang ye lugs te lnga/ de nas rje btsun grags pa'i mnal lam du sa chen gyis gnang ba brda don gsal ba ste drug go /bco brgyad la de rnams bsnan pas nyer bzhi'o/ /yang lam 'bras rang re'i brgyud pa 'di la/ ngor rdzong du grags pa gnyis ka tshang tshul ji ltar yin phebs pa la/ spyir lam 'bras sa lugs nye brgyud ring brgyud gcig tu grags pa 'di la/ chos rje bla ma yan chad du lta ci smos/ de rjes kyang gzungs kyi dpa' ba dang*/ dge legs bzang po dang*/ bzang po rgyal mtshan pa ste/ rdzong pa rnams dang*/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ de'i slob ma 'gro mgon dpal ldan tshul khrims pa dang*/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*/ bud+dha shrī ba shar ba pa dang*/ nam za brag phug pa'i slob ma rnams kyi dus na yang phyag len mi 'dra ba ye med/ sa paṇa yan chad 'khrid 'chad pa'ang glegs bam gyi nang nas 'dzub tshugs su btus te 'chad/ de rjes tshogs sgom pas 'khrid yig mdzad/ de'i slob ma nyan chen pa dang*/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan gyis kyang 'khrid yig re brtsams/ bar skabs der zhal shes dang ma bral ba'i ngos nas khrid yig de dag la yang brten te 'chad/ chos rje bla mas kyang 'khrid yig gi rtsom gzhi de rnams la mdzad/ glegs bam nyid dang yang btun te/ zhal shes lag len gyis brgyan pa 'di mdzad/ de rjes nas ngor dgon gsar ma thebs kyi bar la/ sa skya ba thams cad 'khrid yig 'di ka'i steng nas byed pa 'dug /ngor btab pa nas gzung ste/ phyag len mi 'dra ba re mdzad/ snang gsum lta khrid bskyed rim rnams la dmigs pa mi 'dra ba du ma re yang byung ngo*/ /de la skabs 'dir ngor lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ rje ngor pa mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mchog /bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub/ de la rje grol mchog gis lam 'bras kyi dbang byin rlabs 'khrid man ngag lung bka' thams cad mtha' rgyas su lan bzhi gsan/

brgyud pa'i gtso bo yang 'di la mdzad/ yang rje ngor pa paṇa chen shāka mchog /rin po che gzhon nu chos grub pa rje grol mchog ste snga ma'i : 'og （《dzaṃ》 'go ） nas brgyud pa 'di gtso bor yang mdzad/ gzhan yang ngor chen/ dbon po kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ glo bo mkhan chen rje btsun/ yang ngor chen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge ngor pa lha mchog seng ge rje btsun rnams brgyud byang chog go /ngor lugs brgyud pa mi 'dra ba bzhi 'dus/ rdzong lugs dang phyogs mthun theg chen lugs la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ theg chen chos rje/ lcang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ paṇa chen shāka mchog /rje gzhon nu chos grub pa'i drung du rje btsun gy-is gsan pa dang*/ de rnams thams cad nged kyi bla ma rje btsun rdo ring ba rting ma don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du bdag gis mnos pa dang*/ rdzong lugs dngos la/ chos rje bla ma/ gzungs kyi dpa' ba/ rgyal mtshan dkon mchog pa/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ de la dkon mchog dpal pa dang*/ shes rin pa gnyis de gnyis ka la paṇa chen lha dbang pa/ rje nam mkha' rin chen/ rje btsun brag stong pa'i drung du/ rgyu lam gyi dbang dang 'khrid thob/ yang theg chen pa/ brag thog pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rig pa'i glog 'phreng*/ rgya ston byang dbang*/ yang na mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ byams pa chos dpal 'byor/ rgya ston byang dbang*/ de nas shākya kun dga'/ rje ye shes dbang po'i drung du yab yum gyi rgyu dbang lam dbang 'khrid kyi snying po tsam zhus so/ /rdzong pa rang dang theg chen lugs labarten pa rgyud lugs bzhi/ de dag ni ngor rdzong gnyis ka 'dus tshul lags so/ /yang da ltar lam 'bras byed pa 'di la/ brgyud pa lugs srol bco brgyad las ji tsam zhig tshang ba yin gsung pa ni sa lugs kyi brgyud pa nye ring gnyis gzhir bcas/

zha ma pho brgyud mo brgyud gnyis 'dres/ ko brag pa jo nang lugs phag gru lugs rnams la 'khrid gdams ngag ci rigs dang*/ thams cad la lung rgyun cha tshang tsam yod pas/ lugs srol brgyad 'gres par byed/ cha ga na lugs bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi lung tsam yod/ rang lugs 'dir ngor rdzong lugs dang*/ slob bshad de gsum po la gcig tu nges par ltos med dgos pa'i nges gnas kyang ci phebs pa/ slob bshad mar grags pa 'di brgyud pa gong du smos pa'i ngor lugs dang bdag chen blo gros pa la thug par byed/ de la rdo ring kun spangs pa dang*/ mtshar chen gyis zhus zer/ lag len ngor lugs spyi dang mthun/ 'khrid la shin tu khyad che/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal sogs kyi dmigs pa yang ston par 'dug mtshar ba'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis/ snang gsum gyi skabs su dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta khrid yongs rdzogs bcug pa'ang 'dug gang ltar na'ang slob bshad ma ngor lugs su ka 'dus par 'dod/ ngor lugs spyi 'di la'ang gsar rnying gnyis yod/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi 'di gsar shos yin lags/ rang re'i brgyud pa'i lugs gcig la gong du smos pa de 'dus pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa la nya dbon gyis gsan/ yang gangs khrod pa la bla chen rdo rje rin chen gyis gsan/ de gnyis ka la grub chen kun blos gsan/ yang bla ma dam pa la mkhan rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de dang grub chen kun blo gnyis ka la 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang pos gsan/ de la bdag chen blo gros pa/ de la kun dga' mchog grub/ de la rje btsun grol mchog gis gsan pa yin pas brgyud pa 'di ngor rdzaung gnyis ka la mi the/ lag len ni rdzong lugs dang mthun shas che'o/ /rdzong pa rnams thog ma rang nas rgyu dbang bskur/ ngor pa snang gsum dang rgyud gsum gyi bar du rgyu dbang bskur/ 'di lag len mi 'dra ba che shos su 'dug de la brten nas 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa sogs la mi 'dra ba mang du byung na'ang rang lugs la dbang bskur mtshams rang rgyud gsum gyi sngon du bskur phyin/

gang du bskur kyang 'dra/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa sogs la khyad med/ yig brgya maṇ+ḍal yan lag lnga sbyongs rang yi dam du dran tsam pa sogs la/ dbang bskur sngon du song na'ang bzang mod/ ma song na yang skyon ye med de/ slob dpon la gsang sgrogs kyang mi 'byung*/ slob ma sgom pa la mi dbang ba yang ma yin te/ lha sgom sngags bzlas de tsam ni ma ṇi'i sgom bzlas kyis rig pa mtshungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rlung tsam bzung nas lus sbyong phran bu byed pa 'di nya pa dang*/ mu tig gsod mkhan sogs dang yang thun mong yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'khrid yig chos rje bla ma yan chad kyi rnying pa rnams dang ma mthun na skyon du 'gyur ba srid/ gsar pa rnams dang ma mthun pa ni yon tan yin kyi skyon ma yin no/ /gzhan yang rgya gar gyi yul nas grub thob shing rta'i srol 'byed rtsa ba tha dad pas so sor bkral ba'i lugs tha dad pa rnams ma 'dres pa gtsang mar byung na legs mod kyang*/ ngor rdzong sogs so sor 'byed pa ni/ bod rang du'ang phyis 'byung rang byung ba yin pas/ 'di rnams kyi so so'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos rnams so sor ma 'dres pa dgos pa ma yin te/ 'thad na gnyis ka nas kyang blang du rung*/ mi 'thad na gnyis ka spangs pas kyang chog ste/ bod kyi dge bshes phal ba'i rnam rtog tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngor rdzong lag len mi 'dra ba byung nas da dung lo nyis brgya ma lon/ phyed nyis brgya lhag tsam gyi skabs na yod/ slob bshad mar grags pa byung nas brgya yang ma lon/ bdun bcu'i skor la yod/ de'i nang tshan 'ga' zhig byung nas lo bzhi bcu tsam las mi 'gro ba'ang lags/ lam 'bras sa lugs la lan cig zhugs nas/ glegs bam yig sna drug cu'i lugs skyong dgos pa yin gyi/ phyis kyi gang zag 'ga'i rtog pa'i ri mo la che thang du 'bad don mi 'dug /yang lam 'bras glegs bam la yang dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi 'khrid yig zer ba yig chung de la ngor rdzong gnyis la mi 'dra ba 'dug

/'khrul gzhi de rigs bdud las su 'dug na'ang*/ rang re tshig sna ring zhing rgyas pa de dag par byed lags/ bla ma dam pa'i 'khrid yig 'di glegs bam rang dang mthun nges lags shing*/ rtsom pa po gang zag gi dbang du byas na'ang*/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan 'gran zla med cing*/ gong ma lnga las kyang mi zhan pa yin/ dge bshes phal pa ma yin sprul pa'i sku yin par 'dug pas/ rang re khong gi 'khrid yig la rtsis po cher byed pa yin lags/ zhus dag /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/stag lung zhabs drung gi gsung lan bzhugs/ - PAGE 466 -- PAGE 465 -- PAGE 459 -
